description: Start transcribing an audio or video file your user attached in this chat. convert.express downloads it from the chat's temporary link. Returns job_id; then poll get_job.

action_items.description: Also extract action items when the transcript is ready.

file.description: An audio or video file your user attached in this chat.

download_url.description: Temporary https:// link to the file, filled in by the chat client.

file_id.description: The chat client's id for the file.

file_name.description: Original file name, shown in the job.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code such as "en". Omit to auto-detect.

robot_key.description: Pass the robot_key from your earlier jobs so all your jobs stay together. Omit on your very first call — a new one is returned.

summary.description: Also write an AI summary when the transcript is ready.

translate_to_english.description: Translate the speech to English while transcribing. Only with model "whisper".

name: transcribe_file
title: Transcribe an attached file
